summary: Patch correctly fixes the precision loss by passing through native Decimal inputs untouched instead of round-tripping them through float; non-Decimal paths are unchanged, so no regression. Minimal, targeted, and mergeable.

issues.description: Special Decimal values (NaN, Infinity) now bypass the previous float-normalization path (which turned them into Decimal('nan')/etc.) and reach the formatting logic as the original Decimal object. Downstream as_tuple()/quantize handling appears robust, but this is a subtle behavior shift worth a regression test; not merge-blocking.
The nested try/except inside the else branch is a bit dense; a maintainer might prefer flattening, but it preserves the exact original fallback semantics so readability is acceptable.
